# Wavefront Plotting Units Update

## Summary of changes
- Refactored unit determination logic into a helper function `_get_smart_extent` in `src/helios/core/simulation.py`.
- Updated `Wavefront.plot()` to use `_get_smart_extent` for unit-aware axes (e.g., mm, arcsec) and removed "(arb. units)" from the amplitude colorbar label.
- Updated `WavefrontArray.plot()` to use the shared `_get_smart_extent` function for consistency.

## Files modified
- `src/helios/core/simulation.py`

## New functions/classes
- `_get_smart_extent(shape, pixel_scale)`: Helper function for determining plot extent and labels.

## Tests/validation
- Created and ran `tools/test_plot_units.py` to verify that plotting functions execute without errors for both meter and arcsecond scales.
- Visual verification in notebooks will show correct units on axes.
